title: Nmap before 7.992 Heap Address Disclosure via Predictable NSE Lua Seed
description: CVE-2026-137979 is a vulnerability in Nmap versions before 7.992 involving heap address disclosure due to a predictable NSE Lua seed. This flaw could allow an attacker to gain information about heap memory addresses, potentially aiding further exploitation. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
